standard_prerequisites.name: Constructibility over a Noetherian scheme is inherited by subsheaves and colimits
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the proposition stating that on a Noetherian scheme the constructible sheaves of sets, abelian groups or modules form a well-behaved family closed under the relevant operations
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that the members of the chain and their colimit are constructible.

standard_prerequisites.name: Constructible sheaves are finitely generated under filtered colimits
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma expressing a constructible sheaf as the union of the images of maps from finitely many generators
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the stabilisation of the chain.

core_obligations: Inherit constructibility (proof lines 12914-12916): by the proposition on constructibility over a Noetherian scheme the subsheaves F_i and the colimit of the chain are constructible.

Conclude stabilisation (proof lines 12917-12918): the finite generation property of constructible sheaves for filtered colimits applied to the presentation of F as the union of the F_i gives an index n beyond which the chain is constant.
proof_roadmap: Use the Noetherian constructibility proposition to keep the chain inside the constructible objects.
Apply the finite generation property of constructible sheaves to the colimit presentation to get stabilisation.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the ascending chain condition for subsheaves of a constructible sheaf on a Noetherian scheme, in the three coefficient settings (statement lines 12900-12911). The proof (proof lines 12913-12918) keeps the chain inside the constructible objects by the Noetherian constructibility proposition and applies the finite generation property of constructible sheaves. H2: two short inputs, written out.
